_comment: Singleton via the autoname-on-hidden-field trick: every doc is named the same value via a hidden field, so only one row can exist (uniqueness on `name` enforces it). The after_migrate hook in friday.friday_core.llm.after_migrate creates the row on fresh sites. We use this rather than `issingle: 1` because Single doctypes store all fields in tabSingles as key-value rows which is less efficient and harder to reason about; a regular DocType with autoname-on-constant gives us the same admin UX (one row, edit-only) with normal column semantics.

fields.label: Default LLM Provider
fields.description: Fallback provider used when an Agent Profile has no model_provider set. Leave blank if you always set model_provider explicitly on each profile.

fields.label: Compression (Aux) Model Provider
fields.description: Optional cheap/fast provider used to summarise old turns when a conversation is compressed (Feature C). Leave blank to reuse the agent's own provider. If neither resolves, compression is skipped with a logged warning (turns are never silently dropped).

Set by the Friday Setup wizard (design 64) when setup is finished AND verified (a live provider probe + a non-down pipeline health). A proxy for 'Friday is ready'; the minimum-viable signal is still default_provider + one Active Agent Profile.
fields.label: Setup Complete

fields.description: Maximum depth of the parent_task chain for delegated tasks (design 69, Q3). An orchestrator at depth 3 cannot delegate further. Enforced at dispatch time.
fields.label: Max Delegation Depth

fields.description: Absolute ceiling for delegation depth (design 69, Q3). Cannot be exceeded even if max_delegation_depth is set higher. Safety backstop; change only via bench console.
fields.label: Delegation Depth Hard Ceiling

fields.description: How many agent turns the dedicated 'friday' queue runs at once. 1 (default) = today's single-worker behaviour, zero change. Higher values start that many friday worker PROCESSES so concurrent chats/tasks overlap their model-wait instead of queueing (proven ~5x throughput at 10 concurrent turns on Legion). Clamped to 1..16 in code. Takes effect when the friday worker is (re)started.
fields.label: Max Concurrent Turns

fields.description: Self-improvement review (design 79/80): after every N conversational turns the agent reflects on the conversation and saves durable facts/preferences to memory. 0 = off. Only conversational (gateway) turns count; pipeline tasks never trigger it.
fields.label: Memory Review Interval

fields.description: Governed skill-proposal review (design 79 Slice 2): after every N conversational turns the agent reviews the conversation for reusable how-to lessons and PROPOSES skill changes (Skill Proposal rows, Pending human approval — never auto-applied). 0 = off (default until validated in production).
fields.label: Skill Review Interval

fields.description: Optional LLM Provider used to RUN the self-improvement review (a cheap model is fine — it just reads the conversation and writes short facts). Leave blank to use the agent's own provider.
fields.label: Review Model Provider

fields.description: Design 96 — route non-text mediums (image, doc-render; video/audio when providers land) to a specific LLM Provider, independent of each agent's text provider. Example: agents chat on Codex but 'image' routes to an OpenAI gpt-image provider. A medium with no route falls through to the agent's own provider chain; the routed provider's Design-94 fallback chain still applies.
fields.label: Model Routes (per medium)
